end.summary:
Practised distinguishing physical and chemical changes using ice cream, ghee, roti and milk.
Identified roti baking as a chemical change because colour and smell change.
Recognised chemical-change signs, including heat, light and formation of a new solid.
Physical-change definition and examples were attempted three times without unaided success; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised sorting changes by asking whether a new substance forms. They explained that baking roti is chemical because its colour and smell change, and later identified formation of a new solid as a chemical-change sign; the heat/light mix-up was clarified during the lesson. At home, ask them to classify melting ice, tearing paper and cooking an egg, giving the reason for each.
